Container.Name: LocalAIR
Container.Overview:
LocalAIR is a local climate dashboard for a Tuya IR temperature/humidity device.
This local template uses an image already built on the Unraid server:
localair:latest
Use this if you built the image manually with:
docker build -t localair:latest .
For normal public installs, use localair.xml after the public image exists.
Container.Requires: Before first start, create /mnt/user/appdata/localair/config.toml from config.example.toml and set the Tuya local device details.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port LocalAIR listens on. Host networking is used, so normal Docker port mappings are not used.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone used for graph labels and timestamps. Example: Australia/Perth

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Container data directory. Usually leave as /data.

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: Config file path inside the container. Usually leave as /data/config.toml.

Config.Name: Database File
Config.Description: SQLite database path inside the container. Usually leave as /data/localair.db.

Config.Name: Host Bind
Config.Description: Address LocalAIR binds to inside host networking. Usually leave as 0.0.0.0.

Config.Name: Access Logs
Config.Description: Set to true only when debugging HTTP requests. Normal installs should leave this disabled to avoid noisy Docker logs.
